# اِسْتَدْرَكْتَ (istadrakta) /is.tad.rak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
# اِسْتَدْرَكْتِ (istadrakti) /is.tad.rak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
# اِسْتَدْرَكَتْ (istadrakat) /is.t
